_comment: The monsters a yearly event brings out in the wild, read by Managers/EventGuests.cs.
While its event runs (SeasonalEvents.IsOn, which the server's Events page can hold open or
shut) and the Events page leaves the event monsters on, each group on a map being loaded is
judged once: with the page's chance it takes one guest. When the event closes, the group
gets its own member back. Dungeon rooms, groups in a fight and composed groups are left alone.
The world's own groups name these monsters too (the subareas' lists do): while their event is
shut, or the event monsters are off, each gives way to a member of its group (or its ordinary
self, or a monster of the map's zone) and comes back when the event opens.
replace: monster -> event monster. A group holding one of these has that member replaced:
a Gobball by an Al Howin Gobball.
area:    and joins: one member of any group in that area becomes one of these.
The guest takes the grade whose level is nearest the member it replaces.

events.why: Al Howin: the Gobballs and Gobblies wear pumpkin masks (Al Howin Gobball, 793) and so do the Tofus (Al Howin Tofu, 794), the event's own monsters in the client's data.
Kwismas: the Kwismas Minotoball (2819) and the Kwismas Dragoturkeys (3117, 3118, 3119) roam Frigost (area 48) among its own monsters while the server's Kwismas event runs.
